we preliminarily judged that the irregular blocky phase between dendrites is the γ phase. This type of blocky γ phase is recorded as γblocky ( γb ) to distinguish it from the γ lamellae ( γL ).
The main phase composition of Ti-46Al-xZr includes the α2 and γ phases.
The primary and secondary dendrite arms are perpendicular to each other, indicating that the primary phase of solidification from liquid phase is the β phase.
The microstructure changes from fully lamellar to a nearly lamellar microstructure composed of lamellar colonies and inter-dendritic blocky phases.
Both Al and Zr are also predominantly distributed in this light-grey-coloured segregation; however, the amount of Al and Zr in this segregation is obviously lower than that in γb
which is attributed to solid solution strengthening and the coordinated deformation of blocky γ phase.

continuous and discontinuous coarsening occur simultaneously; the former is observed inside the colony, whereas the latter occurs between two adjacent lamellar colonies.
which results in an obvious lattice distortion that hinders the dislocation movement; this plays a significant role in solid solution strengthening.
The high-temperature tensile results show that the ultimate tensile strength at 800 ◦ C of the Ti-46Al-4Zr alloy (692 MPa) is significantly greater than that of the Ti-46Al alloy (351 MPa)
